name: Aniline
aliases: Anilina, Anilin, Aminobenzene, Aminophen, Aniline oil, Aniline reagent, Anilinum, Anyvim
summary: Aniline is an organic compound with the formula C6H5NH2. Consisting of a phenyl group (−C6H5) attached to an amino group (−NH2), aniline is the simplest aromatic amine. It is an industrially significant commodity chemical, as well as a versatile starting material for fine chemical synthesis. Its main use is in the manufacture of precursors to polyurethane, dyes, and other industrial chemicals.

uses.text: Aniline is predominantly used for the preparation of methylenedianiline and related compounds by condensation with formaldehyde. The diamines are condensed with phosgene to give methylene diphenyl diisocyanate, a precursor to urethane polymers.

summaryZh: 苯胺（英語：Aniline）又稱阿尼林油、氨基苯，分子式：C6H7N（結構簡式：C6H5NH2），分子量：93.128，CAS編號：62-53-3。苯胺是最重要的芳香族胺之一，腐魚味，燃燒的火焰會生煙。純品為無色液體。
summaryZhHans: 苯胺（英语：Aniline）又称阿尼林油、氨基苯，分子式：C6H7N（结构简式：C6H5NH2），分子量：93.128，CAS编号：62-53-3。苯胺是最重要的芳香族胺之一，腐鱼味，燃烧的火焰会生烟。纯品为无色液体。

pharmacology.en: It is not a medicine and has no useful action in the body. Once absorbed it oxidises the iron in haemoglobin, producing methaemoglobin, which cannot carry oxygen. It also damages red blood cells.
pharmacology.zh: 它不是藥物，在體內沒有有益作用。被吸收後，它會氧化血紅素中的鐵，生成無法攜帶氧氣的變性血紅素，同時也破壞紅血球。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它不是药物，在体内没有有益作用。被吸收后，它会氧化血红素中的铁，生成无法携带氧气的变性血红素，同时也破坏红血球。

sideEffects.en: Aniline is poisonous and is absorbed through the skin. It causes headache, dizziness, blue lips and skin from methaemoglobinaemia, breathlessness, collapse and death. Long-term exposure has been linked to bladder cancer.
sideEffects.zh: 苯胺有毒，並可經皮膚吸收。它會造成頭痛、頭暈，因變性血紅素症而使嘴唇與皮膚發紫，並導致呼吸困難、休克與死亡。長期接觸曾與膀胱癌有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 苯胺有毒，并可经皮肤吸收。它会造成头痛、头晕，因变性血红素症而使嘴唇与皮肤发紫，并导致呼吸困难、休克与死亡。长期接触曾与膀胱癌有关。

fact.en: Aniline gave the world its first synthetic dye: in 1856 the teenage chemist William Perkin, trying to make quinine, instead produced a brilliant purple he called mauveine. Aniline is not a drug at all but an industrial chemical.
fact.zh: 苯胺為世界帶來第一種合成染料：1856 年，少年化學家 William Perkin 原本想製造奎寧，卻做出一種亮紫色染料，他稱之為苯胺紫。苯胺根本不是藥物，而是一種工業化學品。
fact.zhHans: 苯胺为世界带来第一种合成染料：1856 年，少年化学家 William Perkin 原本想制造奎宁，却做出一种亮紫色染料，他称之为苯胺紫。苯胺根本不是药物，而是一种工业化学品。
